name: Kenotic Christology

VINIT.justification: The unmanifest state of the Word before the incarnation event.

TANCH.justification: The final restoration where God is all in all within the closed system of salvation history.

AFWD.justification: The directed morphism from divine transcendence toward immanent human existence.

AREV.justification: The self-emptying descent where the subject divests divine prerogatives.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of divine and human natures into a single person.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-recognition of the Logos as remaining essentially God despite the change in form.

FSPLIT.justification: The single person of Christ branches into distinct divine and human operations.

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of the two natures into the singular identity of the Son.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative state of the resurrected and ascended humanity.

EVALF.justification: The negative state of suffering and death representing the depth of the descent.

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous attribution of both divine and human properties to the same subject.

IFIX.justification: The permanent append-only record of the Christological event.

phase_3.void_description: The silence of the Father before the generation of the Word.
phase_3.true_description: The exaltation of the humanity into the divine life.
phase_3.false_description: The mortality and limitation assumed in the kenotic act.
phase_3.both_description: The mystery of the God-Man existing in two natures without confusion.

steps.domain_action: The eternal pre-existence of the Logos in the Godhead.
The Logos identifies as the eternal Son.
The Logos initiates kenosis by divesting the form of God.
The Logos assumes the form of a servant through incarnation.
The single subject branches into divine and human modes of being.
The human branch experiences the limitation of death on the cross.
The divine branch sustains the life of the world through the passion.
Both suffering and impassibility are held simultaneously in the one person.
The two natures are reunited in the singular resurrected body.
The work of Christ chains the human condition to the divine life.
The apostolic witness fixes the event in the historical record.
The ascended Christ anchors the system within the eternal throne.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Holy Spirit as the agent of the incarnation.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The perichoresis or mutual indwelling of the persons.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: Sacred Tradition as the retrieval mechanism for the Christ-event.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The Kairos or the fullness of time.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The voluntary limitation of divine power.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Divine transcendence apart from the created order.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: The created order integrated into the divine life.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The divinity is not diminished by the assumption of humanity.
